Name: ACType
Notes:
0: Single Phase
1: Split Phase
2: Three Phase

Name: InvSt
Notes:
1: OFF
2: SLEEPING
3: STARTING
4: RUNNING
5: THROTTLED
6: SHUTTING_DOWN
7: FAULT
8: STANDBY

Name: ConnSt
Description: Grid connection state of the DER.

Name: Alrm
Notes:
1: DC Over Voltage
2: AC Disconnect Open
3: DC Disconnect Open
4: Grid Disconnect
5: Cabinet Open
6: Manual Shutdown
7: Over Temperature
8: Frequency Above Limit
9: Frequency Under Limit
10: AC Voltage Above Limit
11: AC Voltage Under Limit
12: Blown String Fuse On Input
13: Under Temperature
14: Generic Memory Or Communication Error (Internal)
15: Hardware Test Failure
16: Manufacturer Alarm

Name: DERMode
Description: Current operational characteristics of the DER.

Name: W
Description: Total active power. Active power is positive for DER generation and negative for absorption.

Name: PF
Description: Power factor. The sign of power factor should be the sign of active power.

Name: LLV
Description: Line to line AC voltage as an average of active phases.

Name: LNV
Description: Line to neutral AC voltage as an average of active phases.

Name: ThrotPct
Description: Throttling in pct of maximum active power.

Name: MnAlrmInfo
Description: Manufacturer alarm information. Valid if MANUFACTURER_ALRM indication is active.
